content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-256. - I.E.C.C. Section C105.1, Title.
content.summary:
Section C101.1. Title,
is hereby amended as follows:
"
C101.1. Title.
This code shall be known as the International Energy Conservation Code of the City
                  of Arvada, and shall be cited as such. It is referred to herein as "this code."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 7, 9-14-2020)
